mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_wallet (user_id, balance, frozen, total_recharge, total_spent, version, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user) VALUES (#{userId}, #{balance}, #{frozen}, #{totalRecharge}, #{totalSpent}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stellar_wallet WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stellar_wallet_transaction (wallet_id, user_id, type, amount, balance_after, channel, biz_type, biz_id, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{channel}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stellar_wallet_transaction WHERE user_id = #{userId}
